mapper.select: /* 설 명 : 과목별퀴즈목록조회 */ SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM , BSC.* FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC WHERE 1 = 1 AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ'
/* 설 명 : 과목별시험목록조회 */ SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM , BSC.* FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC WHERE 1 = 1 AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND EXAM_TYCD = 'EXAM'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.profQuizListPaging 설 명 : 교수퀴즈목록페이징 */
WITH SBJCT_USER AS ( -- 과목 수강생 (청강생 제외) SELECT ATNDLC.USER_ID, SBJCT.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID WHERE ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ), ABSNCE_USER AS ( -- 결시승인 수강생 SELECT USER_ID, EXAM_BSC_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE WHERE ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' AND USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER) ), TEAM_USER AS ( -- 팀 수강생 SELECT TEAM_MBR.USER_ID, BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR TEAM_MBR JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR EXAM_TRGTR ON TEAM_MBR.TEAM_ID = EXAM_TRGTR.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON EXAM_TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID = DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN = 'N' AND DTL.USEYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.USEYN = 'Y' AND BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ_TEAM', 'QUIZ_EXAM_MID_TEAM', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST_TEAM') WHERE TEAM_MBR.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER) ), /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- 퀴즈구분별 대상자 통합 ( EXAM_GBNCD ) 1. QUIZ : 수강생 전체 2. QUIZ_EXAM_MID / QUIZ_EXAM_LST : 수강생 중 결시승인 수강생 제외 3. QUIZ_TEAM : 팀 수강생 전체 4. QUIZ_EXAM_MID_TEAM / QUIZ_EXAM_LST_TEAM : 팀 수강생 중 결시승인 수강생 제외 5. EXAM_MID_SBST_QUIZ / EXAM_LST_SBST_QUIZ(대체퀴즈) : 결시승인 수강생 ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */ TARGET_USER AS ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID, SU.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN SBJCT_USER SU ON SU.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID WHERE BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.USEYN = 'Y' AND BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = 'QUIZ'
UNION ALL
SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID, SU.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN SBJCT_USER SU ON SU.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID WHERE BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.USEYN = 'Y' AND BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ_EXAM_MID', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ABSNCE_USER AU WHERE AU.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND AU.USER_ID = SU.USER_ID)
UNION ALL
SELECT TU.EXAM_BSC_ID, TU.USER_ID FROM TEAM_USER TU JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = TU.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = 'QUIZ_TEAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT TU.EXAM_BSC_ID, TU.USER_ID FROM TEAM_USER TU JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = TU.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ_EXAM_MID_TEAM', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ABSNCE_USER AU WHERE AU.EXAM_BSC_ID = TU.EXAM_BSC_ID AND AU.USER_ID = TU.USER_ID)
UNION ALL
SELECT AU.EXAM_BSC_ID, AU.USER_ID FROM ABSNCE_USER AU JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = AU.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_MID_SBST_QUIZ', 'EXAM_LST_SBST_QUIZ') ), TRGT_CNT AS ( -- 대상자 수 SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID, COUNT(*) AS TRGTR_CNT FROM TARGET_USER GROUP BY EXAM_BSC_ID ), TKEXAM_USER AS ( -- 응시 완료자 SELECT TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID , DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID , TKEXAM.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID WHERE TKEXAM.DELYN = 'N' AND TKEXAM.TKEXAM_CMPTNYN = 'Y' AND TKEXAM.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER) ), EXAMNEE_CNT AS ( -- 응시 완료자 수 (대상자에 한함) SELECT TE.EXAM_BSC_ID, COUNT(*) AS EXAMNEE_CNT FROM TKEXAM_USER TE JOIN TARGET_USER TG ON TG.EXAM_BSC_ID = TE.EXAM_BSC_ID AND TG.USER_ID = TE.USER_ID GROUP BY TE.EXAM_BSC_ID ), EVL_USER AS ( -- 평가 완료자 SELECT TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID , DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID , TKEXAM.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON RSLT.TKEXAM_ID = TKEXAM.TKEXAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID WHERE TKEXAM.DELYN = 'N' AND RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' AND TKEXAM.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER) ), EVLTEE_CNT AS ( -- 평가 완료자 수 (대상자에 한함) SELECT EU.EXAM_DTL_ID, COUNT(*) AS EVLTEE_CNT FROM EVL_USER EU JOIN TARGET_USER TG ON TG.EXAM_BSC_ID = EU.EXAM_BSC_ID AND TG.USER_ID = EU.USER_ID GROUP BY EU.EXAM_DTL_ID ), QSTN_CNT AS ( -- 문항 수 SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID, COUNT(*) AS QSTN_CNT FROM TB_LMS_QSTN WHERE QSTN_CNDDT_SEQNO = 1 AND DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY EXAM_DTL_ID ), EXAM_DTL_1ST AS ( -- EXAM_BSC 당 최초 1건의 EXAM_DTL SELECT DTL.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXAM_BSC_ID ORDER BY EXAM_DTL_ID) AS RNUM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL WHERE DTL.DELYN = 'N' AND DTL.USEYN = 'Y' ), QUIZ_LIST AS ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID , BSC.EXAM_GBNCD , CD.CDNM AS EXAM_GBNNM , BSC.EXAM_TTL , DTL.EXAM_MNTS , DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM , DTL.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM , BSC.MRK_RFLTYN , BSC.MRK_RFLTRT , GREATEST(NVL(EN.EXAMNEE_CNT, 0), 0) AS EXAM_EXAMNEE_CNT , GREATEST(NVL(EV.EVLTEE_CNT, 0), 0) AS EXAM_EVLTEE_CNT , GREATEST(NVL(TC.TRGTR_CNT, 0), 0) AS EXAM_TRGTR_CNT , BSC.EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN , BSC.MRK_OYN , NVL(QC.QSTN_CNT, 0) AS QSTN_CNT , DTL.REEXAMYN , DTL.REEXAM_PSBL_SDTTM , DTL.REEXAM_PSBL_EDTTM , CASE WHEN SYSDATE < TO_DATE(DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'PRE_EXAM' WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(DTL.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN SYSDATE > TO_DATE(DTL.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS EXAM_PRGRS_STS , BSC.REG_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN EXAM_DTL_1ST DTL ON DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND DTL.RNUM = 1 LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD ON CD.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' AND CD.CD = BSC.EXAM_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TRGT_CNT TC ON TC.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID LEFT JOIN EXAMNEE_CNT EN ON EN.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID LEFT JOIN EVLTEE_CNT EV ON EV.EXAM_DTL_ID = DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID LEFT JOIN QSTN_CNT QC ON QC.EXAM_DTL_ID = DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND BSC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.USEYN = 'Y' ) SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID, EXAM_DTL_ID, EXAM_GBNCD, EXAM_GBNNM, EXAM_TTL, EXAM_MNTS, EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, MRK_RFLTYN, MRK_RFLTRT, EXAM_EXAMNEE_CNT, EXAM_EVLTEE_CNT, EXAM_TRGTR_CNT, EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN, MRK_OYN, QSTN_CNT, REEXAMYN, REEXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, REEXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, EXAM_PRGRS_STS, REG_DTTM, COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM DESC, EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM ASC) AS LINE_NO FROM QUIZ_LIST
WHERE LOWER(EXAM_TTL) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue}))
ORDER BY EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM DESC, EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM ASC

/* SQL ID : ExamMapper.quizBscSelect 설 명 : 퀴즈기본조회 */ WITH EXAM AS ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , (SELECT MAX(EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM) FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND USEYN = 'Y' AND DELYN = 'N') AS EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM , EVL_SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST EVL_SBST ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = EVL_SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'EXAM' AND BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_MID', 'EXAM_LST') ), SBJCT_USER AS ( SELECT ATNDLC.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EXAM_BSC ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = EXAM_BSC.SBJCT_ID AND EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} WHERE ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' ) SELECT EXAM_BSC.* , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = EXAM_BSC.RGTR_ID) AS RGTRNM , (SELECT SBJCTNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT WHERE SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = EXAM_BSC.SBJCT_ID) AS SBJCTNM , (SELECT DVCLAS_NO FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT WHERE SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = EXAM_BSC.SBJCT_ID) AS DVCLAS_NO , (SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID FROM EXAM WHERE EXAM.EXAM_SBST_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID) AS PAR_EXAM_BSC_ID , (SELECT EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM FROM EXAM WHERE EXAM.EXAM_SBST_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID) AS PAR_EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM , CASE WHEN EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%SBST%' THEN (SELECT COUNT(TKEXAM.USER_ID) FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL EXAM_DTL JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM ON EXAM_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID WHERE TKEXAM.TKEXAM_CNT > 0 AND TKEXAM_SDTTM IS NOT NULL AND EXAM_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND TKEXAM.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE WHERE ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' AND EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER))) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(TKEXAM.USER_ID) FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL EXAM_DTL JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM ON EXAM_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID WHERE TKEXAM.TKEXAM_CNT > 0 AND TKEXAM_SDTTM IS NOT NULL AND EXAM_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND TKEXAM.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER)) END AS TKEXAM_STRT_USER_CNT , (SELECT TEAM_GRP_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM WHERE TEAM_ID = (SELECT TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR WHERE EXAM_DTL_ID = (SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND USEYN = 'Y' AND DELYN = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1))) AS TEAM_GRP_ID , (SELECT TEAM_GRPNM FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP WHERE USEYN = 'Y' AND DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT_ID = EXAM_BSC.SBJCT_ID AND TEAM_GRP_ID = (SELECT TEAM_GRP_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM WHERE TEAM_ID = (SELECT TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR WHERE EXAM_DTL_ID = (SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND USEYN = 'Y' AND DELYN = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1)))) TEAM_GRPNM , FN_REF_FILE_CNT(EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID) AS FILE_CNT FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EXAM_BSC WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId}
mapper.delete: /* SQL ID : ExamMapper.examTrgtrDelete 설 명 : 시험대상자삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR WHERE EXAM_DTL_ID IN (SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId})
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : ExamDAO.mrkRfltQuizList 설 명 : 성적반영퀴즈목록 */ SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ', 'QUIZ_TEAM') AND USEYN = 'Y' AND DELYN = 'N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.quizGrpSbjctList 설 명 : 퀴즈그룹과목목록조회 */ WITH DVCLAS_SBJCT AS ( SELECT SBJCT_ID , EXAM_BSC_ID , TEAM_GRP_SUBASMT_STNGYN , (SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN ='Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EXAM_BSC WHERE ( EXAM_GRP_ID = (SELECT EXAM_GRP_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND DVCLAS_REGYN = 'Y') OR EXAM_BSC_ID = (SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND DVCLAS_REGYN = 'N') ) AND USEYN = 'Y' AND DELYN = 'N' ) SELECT SBJCT_ID , DVCLAS_NO , (SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID FROM DVCLAS_SBJCT WHERE SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID) AS EXAM_BSC_ID , (SELECT TEAM_GRP_SUBASMT_STNGYN FROM DVCLAS_SBJCT WHERE SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID) AS TEAM_GRP_SUBASMT_STNGYN , (SELECT TEAM_GRP_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM WHERE TEAM_ID = (SELECT TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR WHERE EXAM_DTL_ID = (SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID FROM DVCLAS_SBJCT WHERE SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID))) AS TEAM_GRP_ID , (SELECT TEAM_GRPNM FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP WHERE USEYN = 'Y' AND DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND TEAM_GRP_ID = (SELECT TEAM_GRP_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM WHERE TEAM_ID = (SELECT TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR WHERE EXAM_DTL_ID = (SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID FROM DVCLAS_SBJCT WHERE SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID)))) AS TEAM_GRPNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT WHERE SBJCT_ID IN (SELECT SBJCT_ID FROM DVCLAS_SBJCT) ORDER BY DVCLAS_NO
/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.examBscIdSelect 설 명 : 시험기본아이디조회 */ SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND EXAM_GRP_ID = #{examGrpId} AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.quizTeamList 설 명 : 퀴즈팀목록조회 */ SELECT EXAM_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID , EXAM_TRGTR.TEAM_ID , (SELECT TEAMNM FROM TB_LMS_TEAM WHERE TEAM_CPST_CMPTNYN = 'Y' AND TEAM_ID = EXAM_TRGTR.TEAM_ID) AS TEAMNM , EXAM_DTL.EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL EXAM_DTL JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR EXAM_TRGTR ON EXAM_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = EXAM_TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID WHERE EXAM_DTL.DELYN = 'N' AND EXAM_DTL.USEYN = 'Y' AND EXAM_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId}

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.quizTeamQstnsCmptnynSelect 설 명 : 퀴즈팀문제출제완료여부조회 */ SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(CASE WHEN EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' THEN 1 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.tkexamStrtUserCntSelect 설 명 : 시험응시시작사용자수조회 */ WITH SBJCT_USER AS ( SELECT ATNDLC.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EXAM_BSC ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = EXAM_BSC.SBJCT_ID AND EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} WHERE ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' ), TKEXAM_USER AS ( SELECT TKEXAM.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM WHERE TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID = #{examDtlId} AND TKEXAM.TKEXAM_CNT > 0 AND TKEXAM.TKEXAM_SDTTM IS NOT NULL ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%SBST%' THEN (SELECT COUNT(USER_ID) FROM TKEXAM_USER WHERE USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE WHERE ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' AND EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER))) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(USER_ID) FROM TKEXAM_USER WHERE USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER)) END AS TKEXAM_STRT_USER_CNT FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EXAM_BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL EXAM_DTL ON EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND EXAM_DTL.DELYN = 'N' AND EXAM_DTL.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE EXAM_BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND EXAM_BSC.USEYN = 'Y' AND EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND EXAM_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = #{examDtlId}

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.sbjctDvclasList 설 명 : 과목분반목록조회 */ WITH SBJCT AS ( SELECT PROF_ID , SMSTR_CHRT_ID , CRCLMN_NO FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' ) SELECT SBJCT.SBJCT_ID , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO , SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , SBJCT_ADM.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR_CHRT ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR_CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND SBJCT.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'CHRT' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM SBJCT_ADM ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT_ADM.SBJCT_ID AND SBJCT_ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF' AND SBJCT_ADM.USER_ID = (SELECT PROF_ID FROM SBJCT) WHERE SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' AND SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = (SELECT SMSTR_CHRT_ID FROM SBJCT) AND SBJCT.CRCLMN_NO = (SELECT CRCLMN_NO FROM SBJCT) ORDER BY SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.exampprBulkExcelDownQuizTrgtrList 설 명 : 시험지일괄엑셀다운퀴즈대상자목록조회 */ WITH SBJCT_USER AS ( SELECT ATNDLC.USER_ID, SBJCT.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID WHERE ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ), ABSNCE_USER AS ( -- 결시승인 수강생 SELECT USER_ID, EXAM_BSC_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE WHERE ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' AND EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER) ), TEAM_USER AS ( -- 팀 수강생 SELECT TEAM_MBR.USER_ID, BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID, DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID, EXAM_TRGTR.TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR TEAM_MBR JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR EXAM_TRGTR ON TEAM_MBR.TEAM_ID = EXAM_TRGTR.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON EXAM_TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID = DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN = 'N' AND DTL.USEYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.USEYN = 'Y' AND BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ_TEAM', 'QUIZ_EXAM_MID_TEAM', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} WHERE TEAM_MBR.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER) ), /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- 퀴즈구분별 대상자 통합 (EXAM_GBNCD) 1. QUIZ : 수강생 전체 2. QUIZ_EXAM_MID / QUIZ_EXAM_LST : 수강생 중 결시승인 수강생 제외 3. QUIZ_TEAM : 팀 수강생 전체 4. QUIZ_EXAM_MID_TEAM / QUIZ_EXAM_LST_TEAM : 팀 수강생 중 결시승인 수강생 제외 5. EXAM_MID_SBST_QUIZ / EXAM_LST_SBST_QUIZ(대체퀴즈) : 결시승인 수강생 ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */ TARGET_USER AS ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID, SU.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN SBJCT_USER SU ON SU.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID WHERE BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.USEYN = 'Y' AND BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = 'QUIZ' AND BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId}
UNION ALL
SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID, SU.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN SBJCT_USER SU ON SU.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID WHERE BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.USEYN = 'Y' AND BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ_EXAM_MID', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST') AND BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ABSNCE_USER AU WHERE AU.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND AU.USER_ID = SU.USER_ID)
UNION ALL
SELECT TU.EXAM_BSC_ID, TU.USER_ID FROM TEAM_USER TU JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = TU.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = 'QUIZ_TEAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT TU.EXAM_BSC_ID, TU.USER_ID FROM TEAM_USER TU JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = TU.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ_EXAM_MID_TEAM', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ABSNCE_USER AU WHERE AU.EXAM_BSC_ID = TU.EXAM_BSC_ID AND AU.USER_ID = TU.USER_ID)
UNION ALL
SELECT AU.EXAM_BSC_ID, AU.USER_ID FROM ABSNCE_USER AU JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = AU.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_MID_SBST_QUIZ', 'EXAM_LST_SBST_QUIZ') ), EXAM_DTL_1ST AS ( -- EXAM_BSC 당 최초 1건의 EXAM_DTL SELECT DTL.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXAM_BSC_ID ORDER BY EXAM_DTL_ID) AS RNUM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL WHERE DTL.DELYN = 'N' AND DTL.USEYN = 'Y' AND DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} ), EFF AS ( SELECT TARGET.EXAM_BSC_ID, TARGET.USER_ID, TEAM.TEAM_ID, CASE WHEN BSC.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%TEAM%' THEN TEAM.EXAM_DTL_ID ELSE DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID END AS EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TARGET_USER TARGET ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = TARGET.EXAM_BSC_ID LEFT JOIN EXAM_DTL_1ST DTL ON TARGET.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND DTL.RNUM = 1 LEFT JOIN TEAM_USER TEAM ON TARGET.EXAM_BSC_ID = TEAM.EXAM_BSC_ID AND TARGET.USER_ID = TEAM.USER_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} ) SELECT DEPT.DEPTNM , EFF.USER_ID , USR.USERNM , NVL(TKEXAM.TKEXAM_CMPTNYN, 'N') AS TKEXAM_CMPTNYN , NVL(TKEXAM.RETKEXAM_YN, 'N') AS RETKEXAM_YN , EFF.EXAM_BSC_ID , EFF.EXAM_DTL_ID , ANSW_SHT.QSTN_ID , ANSW_SHT.ANSW_SHT_CTS , ANSW_SHT.SCR FROM EFF JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON EFF.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID AND USR.USER_ID_STSCD = 'APRV_CMPTN' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM ON TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID = EFF.EXAM_DTL_ID AND TKEXAM.USER_ID = EFF.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAMPPR EXAMPPR ON TKEXAM.TKEXAM_ID = EXAMPPR.TKEXAM_ID AND EXAMPPR.USER_ID = EFF.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_ANSW_SHT ANSW_SHT ON EXAMPPR.EXAMPPR_ID = ANSW_SHT.EXAMPPR_ID AND ANSW_SHT.USER_ID = EFF.USER_ID ORDER BY EFF.EXAM_DTL_ID, USR.USERNM, ANSW_SHT.QSTN_ID

NVL(TKEXAM.TKEXAM_CMPTNYN, 'N') AS TKEXAM_CMPTNYN, NVL(TKEXAM.RETKEXAM_YN, 'N') AS RETKEXAM_YN, NVL(RSLT.EVLYN, 'N') AS EVLYN, NVL(RSLT.TOT_SCR, 0) AS TOT_SCR FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EXAM_BSC JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = #{userId} AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' -- 결시승인 : 중간/기말 대체 퀴즈 대상자, 중간/기말 퀴즈 제외 대상자 판별용 LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABSNCE ON ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ABSNCE.USER_ID = #{userId} AND ABSNCE.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' -- 팀 퀴즈 대상자 여부 판별용 (해당 퀴즈의 대상 팀 + 그 팀의 소속원인지 확인) LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR TRGTR ON TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID = EXAM_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR TEAM_MBR ON TEAM_MBR.TEAM_ID = TRGTR.TEAM_ID AND TEAM_MBR.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM ON TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID = EXAM_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID AND TKEXAM.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON RSLT.TKEXAM_ID = TKEXAM.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD = #{sbjctId} AND ( -- 대체퀴즈 : 결시 승인자만 대상 (EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_MID_SBST_QUIZ', 'EXAM_LST_SBST_QUIZ') AND ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID IS NOT NULL) -- 팀 퀴즈 : 소속 팀이 대상 팀인 경우만 OR (EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = 'QUIZ_TEAM' AND TEAM_MBR.USER_ID IS NOT NULL) -- 개인 퀴즈 : 수강생 전체 대상 OR EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = 'QUIZ' -- 중간/기말 퀴즈 : 결시자 제외 OR (EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ_EXAM_MID', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST') AND ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID IS NULL) -- 중간/기말 팀 퀴즈 : 소속 팀이 대상 팀 + 결시자 제외 OR (EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ_EXAM_MID_TEAM', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND TEAM_MBR.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID IS NULL) ) ), QUIZ_WITH_STS AS ( SELECT QUIZ.*, CASE WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(QUIZ.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(QUIZ.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') OR (QUIZ.RETKEXAM_YN = 'Y' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(QUIZ.REEXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(QUIZ.REEXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN SYSDATE < CASE WHEN QUIZ.RETKEXAM_YN = 'Y' THEN TO_DATE(QUIZ.REEXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') ELSE TO_DATE(QUIZ.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') END THEN 'PRE_EXAM' WHEN SYSDATE > CASE WHEN QUIZ.RETKEXAM_YN = 'Y' THEN TO_DATE(QUIZ.REEXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') ELSE TO_DATE(QUIZ.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') END THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS EXAM_PRGRS_STS FROM QUIZ ) SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID, EXAM_DTL_ID, EXAM_GBNCD, EXAM_GBNNM, EXAM_TTL, EXAM_MNTS, EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, MRK_RFLTYN, MRK_OYN, REEXAMYN, REEXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, REEXAM_PSBL_EDTTM, REG_DTTM, TKEXAM_ID, TKEXAM_CNT, TKEXAM_CMPTNYN, RETKEXAM_YN, EVLYN, TOT_SCR, EXAM_PRGRS_STS, COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM DESC, EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM ASC) AS LINE_NO FROM QUIZ_WITH_STS
AND LOWER(EXAM_TTL) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue}))
ORDER BY EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM DESC, EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TO_DATE(D.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC , A.EXAM_BSC_ID ASC) AS "LINE_NO" /* Row Number */ , A.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" /* 시험기본 ID */ , A.EXAM_TYCD AS "EXAM_TYCD" /* 시험유형코드 */ , A.EXAM_GBNCD AS "EXAM_GBNCD" /* 시험구분코드 */ , B.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" /* 시험구분코드명 */ , A.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD AS "TKEXAM_MTHD_CD" /* 시험응시방법코드 */ , CASE WHEN A.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD IS NULL THEN '' ELSE C.CDNM END AS "TKEXAM_MTHD_NM" /* 시험응시방법코드명 */ , A.EXAM_TTL AS "EXAM_TTL" /* 시험제목 */ , D.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" /* 시험 시작일 */ , D.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM" /* 시험 종료일 */ , D.EXAM_MNTS AS "EXAM_MNTS" /* 시험시간 */ , A.MRK_RFLTYN AS "MRK_RFLTYN" /* 성적반영여부 */ , TO_NUMBER(A.MRK_RFLTRT) AS "MRK_RFLTRT" /* 반영비율 */ /* 응시현황: (응시자) / (전체 수강생 - 결시자) */ , CASE /* 시험 - 퀴즈 일 경우 등록된 해당 퀴즈의 응시 인원을 가져와야 함.. */ WHEN A.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = 'QUIZ' THEN CASE WHEN A.BYTEAM_SUBREXAM_USEYN = 'Y' THEN NVL(TKEXAM_TEAM_QUIZ.CNT, 0) ELSE NVL(TKEXAM_INDI_QUIZ.CNT, 0) END ELSE CASE WHEN A.BYTEAM_SUBREXAM_USEYN = 'Y' THEN NVL(TKEXAM_TEAM.CNT, 0) ELSE NVL(TKEXAM_INDI.CNT, 0) END END || '/' || NVL(TOTAL_USR.CNT, 0) AS "TKEXAM_CMPTNYN_TOT" /* 응시현황 */ /* 평가현황: (평가 완료자) / (전체 수강생 - 결시자) */ , CASE /* 시험 - 퀴즈일 경우 등록된 해당 퀴즈의 평가 인원을 가져와야 함.. */ WHEN A.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = 'QUIZ' THEN CASE WHEN A.BYTEAM_SUBREXAM_USEYN = 'Y' THEN NVL(EVLYN_TEAM.CNT, 0) ELSE NVL(EVLYN_INDI.CNT, 0) END ELSE CASE WHEN A.BYTEAM_SUBREXAM_USEYN = 'Y' THEN NVL(EVLYN_TEAM.CNT, 0) ELSE NVL(EVLYN_INDI.CNT, 0) END END || '/' || NVL(TOTAL_USR.CNT, 0) AS "EVLYN_TOT" /* 평가현황 */ , A.EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN AS "EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN" /* 출제상태 */ , A.MRK_OYN AS "MRK_OYN" /* 성적공개 */ , A.BYTEAM_SUBREXAM_USEYN AS "BYTEAM_SUBREXAM_USEYN" /* 팀 시험 여부 */ , A.SBJCT_ID AS "SBJCT_ID" /* 과목 ID */ FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC A /* 시험구분코드 (공통코드) */ JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD B ON A.EXAM_GBNCD = B.CD AND B.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' /* 시험응시방법코드 (공통코드) */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD C ON A.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = C.CD AND C.UP_CD = 'TKEXAM_MTHD_CD' /* 시험상세 - EXAM_BSC_ID당 최신 1건만 선택 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT D.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.EXAM_BSC_ID ORDER BY D.EXAM_DTL_ID DESC) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D WHERE D.DELYN ='N') WHERE RN = 1 ) D ON A.EXAM_BSC_ID = D.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 응시자 수 - 팀 시험: EXAM_BSC_ID별 응시한 팀 멤버 수 (전체 DTL 합산) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR TRGTR JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR ON MBR.TEAM_ID = TRGTR.TEAM_ID WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK WHERE TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID AND TK.USER_ID = MBR.USER_ID ) GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) TKEXAM_TEAM ON TKEXAM_TEAM.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID /* (시험-퀴즈) 응시자 수 - 팀 시험: EXAM_BSC_ID별 응시한 팀 멤버 수 (전체 DTL 합산) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR TRGTR JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_EXAMQUIZ ONQZ ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR ON MBR.TEAM_ID = TRGTR.TEAM_ID WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK WHERE TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID AND TK.USER_ID = MBR.USER_ID ) GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) TKEXAM_TEAM_QUIZ ON TKEXAM_TEAM_QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 응시자 수 - 기본 시험: EXAM_BSC_ID별 응시한 수강생 수 (전체 DTL 합산, ATNDLC 기준) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT TK.USER_ID) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATD ON ATD.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID AND ATD.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ATD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATD.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) TKEXAM_INDI ON TKEXAM_INDI.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID /* (시험-퀴즈) 응시자 수 - 기본 시험: EXAM_BSC_ID별 응시한 수강생 수 (전체 DTL 합산, ATNDLC 기준) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT TK.USER_ID) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_EXAMQUIZ ONQZ ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATD ON ATD.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID AND ATD.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ATD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATD.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) TKEXAM_INDI_QUIZ ON TKEXAM_INDI_QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 평가 완료자 수 - 팀 시험: EXAM_BSC_ID별 EVLYN='Y' 인 팀 멤버 수 (전체 DTL 합산) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR TRGTR JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR ON MBR.TEAM_ID = TRGTR.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK ON TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID AND TK.USER_ID = MBR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON RSLT.TKEXAM_ID = TK.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.USER_ID = MBR.USER_ID WHERE RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) EVLYN_TEAM ON EVLYN_TEAM.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID /* (시험-퀴즈) 평가 완료자 수 - 팀 시험: EXAM_BSC_ID별 EVLYN='Y' 인 팀 멤버 수 (전체 DTL 합산) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR TRGTR JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_EXAMQUIZ ONQZ ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR ON MBR.TEAM_ID = TRGTR.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK ON TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID AND TK.USER_ID = MBR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON RSLT.TKEXAM_ID = TK.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.USER_ID = MBR.USER_ID WHERE RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) EVLYN_TEAM_QUIZ ON EVLYN_TEAM_QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 평가 완료자 수 - 기본 시험: EXAM_BSC_ID별 EVLYN='Y' 인 수강생 수 (전체 DTL 합산, ATNDLC 기준) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT TK.USER_ID) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATD ON ATD.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID AND ATD.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ATD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATD.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON RSLT.TKEXAM_ID = TK.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID WHERE RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) EVLYN_INDI ON EVLYN_INDI.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID /* (시험-퀴즈) 평가 완료자 수 - 기본 시험: EXAM_BSC_ID별 EVLYN='Y' 인 수강생 수 (전체 DTL 합산, ATNDLC 기준) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT TK.USER_ID) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_EXAMQUIZ ONQZ ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATD ON ATD.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID AND ATD.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ATD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATD.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON RSLT.TKEXAM_ID = TK.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID WHERE RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) EVLYN_INDI_QUIZ ON EVLYN_INDI_QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 전체 수강생 수 - 결시 승인자 제외 (TKEXAM_CMPTNYN_TOT, EVLYN_TOT 분모 공통) */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT ATD.USER_ID) AS CNT FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATD JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = ATD.SBJCT_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' WHERE ATD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATD.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABSNCE WHERE ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 결시자 제외 */ AND ABSNCE.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' AND ABSNCE.USER_ID = ATD.USER_ID ) GROUP BY BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ) TOTAL_USR ON TOTAL_USR.EXAM_BSC_ID = A.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} /* 시험 구분이 퀴즈인 것은 제외 */ AND A.EXAM_TYCD NOT LIKE '%QUIZ%' AND A.DELYN = 'N'
AND A.EXAM_TTL LIKE '%' || #{examTtl} || '%'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TO_DATE(SBST.REG_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" , SBST.EXAM_EVL_SBST_ID AS "EXAM_EVL_SBST_ID" , CMMN1.CDNM AS "EXAM_EVL_SBSTNM" , CASE WHEN ASMT.ASMT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ASMT' /* 과제 */ WHEN QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'QUIZ' /* 퀴즈 */ END AS "GBN" /* 과제 */ , ASMT.ASMT_ID AS "ASMT_ID" , ASMT.ASMT_TTL AS "ASMT_TTL" , ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM AS "ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM" , ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM AS "ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM" , ASMT.EVL_SCR_TYCD AS "EVL_SCR_TYCD" , CMMN2.CDNM AS "EVL_SCR_TYNM" /* 퀴즈 */ , QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "QUIZ_BSC_ID" , QUIZ.EXAM_TTL AS "EXAM_TTL" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM" , SBST.REG_DTTM AS "REG_DTTM" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_MNTS AS "EXAM_MNTS" , QUIZ.EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN AS "EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN" , QUIZ.EXAM_GRP_ID AS "EXAM_GRP_ID" /* 공통 */ , CASE WHEN ASMT.ASMT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ASMT.MRK_RFLTYN ELSE QUIZ.MRK_RFLTYN END AS "MRK_RFLTYN" , CASE WHEN ASMT.ASMT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ASMT.MRK_OYN ELSE QUIZ.MRK_OYN END AS "MRK_OYN" FROM /* 시험 기본 */ TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC /* 시험 대체 평가 */ JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST SBST ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN1 ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_TYCD = CMMN1.CD AND CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_SBST_TYCD' /* 과제 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = ASMT.SBJCT_ID AND SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = ASMT.ASMT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN2 ON ASMT.EVL_SCR_TYCD = CMMN2.CD AND CMMN2.UP_CD = 'EVL_SCR_TYCD' /* 퀴즈 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC QUIZ ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AND QUIZ.DELYN ='N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL QUIZ_DTL ON QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND QUIZ_DTL.DELYN ='N' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID =#{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

WITH C_LATEST AS (SELECT C.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C.USER_ID, C.EXAM_BSC_ID ORDER BY C.REG_DTTM DESC) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE C) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.EXAM_BSC_ID DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , E.DEPTNM AS "DEPTNM" -- , D.USER_RPRS_ID AS "USER_RPRS_ID" , D.STDNT_NO AS "STDNT_NO" , D.USER_ID AS "USER_ID" , D.USERNM AS "USERNM" , C.ABSNCE_CTS AS "ABSNCE_CTS" , C.ABSNCE_RFLTRT AS "ABSNCE_RFLTRT" , CASE WHEN C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "APLY_STS_STTS" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = D.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' AND USER_ID = D.USER_ID) AS "EMAIL" FROM /* 시험 기본 */ TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC A /* 과목 수강 */ JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC B ON A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND B.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND B.AUDITYN = 'N' /* 시험 결시: 사용자별 + 시험별 최신 1건 */ JOIN C_LATEST C ON B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND A.EXAM_BSC_ID = C.EXAM_BSC_ID AND C.RN = 1 /* 사용자 */ JOIN TB_LMS_USER D ON B.USER_ID = D.USER_ID /* 학과 */ JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT E ON D.DEPT_ID = E.DEPT_ID WHERE A.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND A.DELYN ='N'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY D.USERNM DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , E.DEPTNM AS "DEPTNM" -- , D.USER_RPRS_ID AS "USER_RPRS_ID" , D.STDNT_NO AS "STDNT_NO" , D.USERNM AS "USERNM" , C.USER_ID AS "USER_ID" , CASE WHEN C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APLY' THEN '1' /* 신청 */ WHEN C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'RE_APLY' THEN '2' /* 재신청 */ WHEN C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' THEN '3' /* 승인 */ WHEN C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'RJCT' THEN '4' /* 거절 */ END AS "APLY_STSNM" , C.REG_DTTM AS "REG_DTTM" , F.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" , C.APRVDTTM AS "APRVDTTM" , C.AUTZR_ID AS "AUTZR_ID" , A.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC A /* 과목 수강 */ JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC B ON A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND B.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND B.AUDITYN = 'N' /* 결시 (학생별 최신 신청 1건) */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT ABSNCE.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXAM_BSC_ID, USER_ID ORDER BY REG_DTTM DESC) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABSNCE) WHERE RN = 1) C ON A.EXAM_BSC_ID = C.EXAM_BSC_ID AND B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID /* 사용자 */ JOIN TB_LMS_USER D ON C.USER_ID = D.USER_ID /* 학과 */ JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT E ON D.DEPT_ID = E.DEPT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD F ON A.EXAM_GBNCD = F.CD AND F.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' WHERE A.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND A.DELYN ='N'
AND C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APLY'
AND C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'RE_APLY'
AND C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV'
AND C.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'RJCT'
AND ( LOWER(E.DEPTNM) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue})) OR LOWER(D.STDNT_NO) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue})) OR LOWER(D.USERNM) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue})) )

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABSNCE.REG_DTTM DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , USR.STDNT_NO AS "STDNT_NO" , USR.USERNM AS "USERNM" , DEPT.DEPTNM AS "DEPTNM" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = ABSNCE.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' AND USER_ID = ABSNCE.USER_ID) AS "EMAIL" , CMMNCD.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" , ABSNCE.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD AS "APLY_STSCD" , ABSNCE.APRVDTTM AS "APRVDTTM" , ABSNCE.ABSNCE_TTL AS "ABSNCE_TTL" , ABSNCE.ABSNCE_RFLTRT AS "ABSNCE_RFLTRT" , ABSNCE.APRV_CTS AS "APRV_CTS" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABSNCE ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ABSNCE.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON USR.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMNCD ON BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = CMMNCD.CD AND CMMNCD.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND ABSNCE.USER_ID = #{userId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

USR.STDNT_NO AS "STDNT_NO" , USR.USERNM AS "USERNM" , CASE WHEN USR.SNRYN = 'Y' THEN 'Seniors' ELSE 'Disabled' END AS "USER_STATUS" , CMMN1.CDNM AS "DSBL_TYNM" , CMMN2.CDNM AS "DSBL_GRDNM" , CASE WHEN SPRT_MID.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "MID_EXAM" , CASE WHEN SPRT_LST.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "FLN_EXAM" , CMMN3.CDNM AS "EXAM_SPRT_APLY_TYNM" , CASE WHEN SPRT_MID.APRVDTTM IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(SPRT_MID.ADD_MNTS) ELSE '' END AS "SPRT_MID_ADD_MNTS" , CASE WHEN SPRT_LST.APRVDTTM IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(SPRT_LST.ADD_MNTS) ELSE '' END AS "LST_EXAM_BSC_ID" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = USR.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' AND USER_ID = USR.USER_ID) AS "EMAIL" , CASE WHEN SPRT_MID.APLY_STSCD = SPRT_LST.APLY_STSCD AND SPRT_MID.APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' THEN CASE WHEN SPRT_MID.ADD_MNTS IS NULL THEN '부여하지 않음' ELSE '연장(' || SPRT_MID.ADD_MNTS || '분)' END || ' / ' || CASE WHEN SPRT_LST.ADD_MNTS IS NULL THEN '부여하지 않음' ELSE '연장(' || SPRT_LST.ADD_MNTS || '분)' END WHEN SPRT_MID.APLY_STSCD = SPRT_LST.APLY_STSCD AND SPRT_MID.APLY_STSCD = 'RJCT' THEN '반려' ELSE '-' END AS "SPRT_RSLT" , MID_CMMN2.CDNM || '/' || LST_CMMN2.CDNM AS "CNCL_APLY_STSNM" FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATN JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATN.USER_ID = /* SQL ID : TkexamDAO.selectUserTkexamStatusForPieChart 설 명 : 사용자 시험 응시현황 (파이)차트데이터 조회 */ SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TKEXAM_CD = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NO_TKEXAM_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TKEXAM_CD = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TEMP_SAVE_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TKEXAM_CD = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS COMPLETE_CNT , NVL(ROUND(AVG(QUIZ_SCR)), 0) AS AVG_SCORE , NVL(MAX(QUIZ_SCR), 0) AS MAX_SCORE , NVL(MIN(QUIZ_SCR), 0) AS MIN_SCORE , NVL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LINE_NO <= CNT THEN QUIZ_SCR ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(CNT,0)),0) AS TOP_AVG_SCORE FROM ( SELECT QUIZ_SCR , TKEXAM_CD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY QUIZ_SCR DESC) AS LINE_NO , COUNT(1) OVER () / 10 AS CNT FROM ( SELECT TKEXAM.QUIZ_SCR , CASE WHEN TKEXAM.TKEXAM_SDTTM IS NULL THEN 'N' WHEN TKEXAM.TKEXAM_EDTTM IS NULL THEN 'T' WHEN TKEXAM.TKEXAM_EDTTM IS NOT NULL THEN 'C' END AS TKEXAM_CD , CASE /* 일반 시험 */ WHEN EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN (SELECT CD FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' AND CD NOT LIKE '%QUIZ%' AND CD NOT LIKE '%TEAM%') THEN CASE WHEN SBJCT_USER.USER_ID NOT IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE WHERE /* 결시자 제외 */ ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' AND EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END /* 팀 시험 */ WHEN EXAM_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD IN (SELECT CD FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' AND CD NOT LIKE '%QUIZ%') THEN CASE WHEN SBJCT_USER.USER_ID IN (SELECT TEAM_MBR.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR TEAM_MBR JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR EXAM_TRGTR ON TEAM_MBR.TEAM_ID = EXAM_TRGTR.TEAM_ID WHERE /* 시험 기본 - 시험 상세 ID 추출 */ EXAM_TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID IN (SELECT EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND USEYN = 'Y' AND DELYN = 'N' ) /* 결시자 제외 */ AND SBJCT_USER.USER_ID NOT IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE WHERE ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' AND EXAM_BSC_ID = EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID)) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END END AS IS_TARGET FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EXAM_BSC JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON EXAM_BSC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID JOIN (SELECT USER_ID , SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC WHERE AUDITYN = 'N' AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) SBJCT_USER ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT_USER.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT TKEXAM.USER_ID , TKEXAM.TKEXAM_SDTTM , TKEXAM.TKEXAM_EDTTM , NVL(SUM(ANSW.SCR), 0) AS QUIZ_SCR FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL EXAM_DTL ON TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID = EXAM_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID AND EXAM_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND EXAM_DTL.USEYN = 'Y' AND EXAM_DTL.DELYN = 'N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAMPPR EXAMPPR ON TKEXAM.TKEXAM_ID = EXAMPPR.TKEXAM_ID AND TKEXAM.USER_ID = EXAMPPR.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_ANSW_SHT ANSW ON EXAMPPR.EXAMPPR_ID = ANSW.EXAMPPR_ID AND EXAMPPR.USER_ID = ANSW.USER_ID WHERE TKEXAM.DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY TKEXAM.USER_ID , TKEXAM.TKEXAM_SDTTM , TKEXAM.TKEXAM_EDTTM ) TKEXAM ON SBJCT_USER.USER_ID = TKEXAM.USER_ID WHERE EXAM_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND EXAM_BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND EXAM_BSC.USEYN = 'Y') WHERE IS_TARGET = 'Y') GROUP BY CNT

/* SQL ID : TkexamDAO.selectUserTkexamStatusForHrChart 설 명 : 사용자 시험 응시현황 (가로선)차트데이터 조회 */ /* 점수 구간 정의 */ WITH SCORE_T AS (SELECT -1 AS SP, 10 AS EP, '0~10' AS LABEL, 1 AS ODR FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 10, 20, '11~20', 2 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 20, 30, '21~30', 3 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 30, 40, '31~40', 4 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 40, 50, '41~50', 5 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 50, 60, '51~60', 6 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 60, 70, '61~70', 7 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 70, 80, '71~80', 8 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 80, 90, '81~90', 9 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 90, 100, '91~100', 10 FROM dual) /* 대상자 목록: SBJCT_ID 파라미터로 수강 학생 조회 (팀 여부 무관) */ , STD_T AS (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} /* 수강중인 수강생만 */ AND ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND AUDITYN = 'N') /* 시험 상세 목록: EXAM_BSC_ID 파라미터로 해당 시험의 EXAM_DTL_ID 조회 */ , EXAM_DTL_T AS (SELECT DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND DTL.DELYN = 'N' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN = 'N') /* TKEXAM_ID 가 없는 미응시자는 이 CTE 에 포함되지 않음 LEFT JOIN 으로 0점 처리 */ , TKEXAM_SCR_T AS (SELECT ANSW.USER_ID , EXAMPPR.TKEXAM_ID , SUM(ANSW.SCR) AS EXAM_SCR FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM_ANSW_SHT ANSW JOIN TB_LMS_EXAMPPR EXAMPPR ON ANSW.EXAMPPR_ID = EXAMPPR.EXAMPPR_ID AND ANSW.USER_ID = EXAMPPR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK ON EXAMPPR.TKEXAM_ID = TK.TKEXAM_ID AND TK.DELYN = 'N' JOIN EXAM_DTL_T ON TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = EXAM_DTL_T.EXAM_DTL_ID GROUP BY ANSW.USER_ID , EXAMPPR.TKEXAM_ID) /* 재응시가 있는 경우 유저당 최고 점수 적용 */ , USER_MAX_SCR_T AS (SELECT USER_ID , MAX(EXAM_SCR) AS SCR FROM TKEXAM_SCR_T GROUP BY USER_ID) /* 대상자 전체 + 점수 결합 (미응시자 = 0점) */ ,EXAM_SCORE_RAW AS (SELECT S.USER_ID , NVL(U.SCR, 0) AS SCR FROM STD_T S LEFT JOIN USER_MAX_SCR_T U ON S.USER_ID = U.USER_ID) SELECT T.LABEL , COUNT(S.USER_ID) AS CNT FROM SCORE_T T LEFT JOIN EXAM_SCORE_RAW S ON T.SP < S.SCR AND T.EP >= S.SCR GROUP BY T.LABEL , T.ODR ORDER BY T.ODR

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectProfSbstQuiz 설명 : 교수 시험대체 퀴즈 조회 */ SELECT QUIZ.EXAM_TTL AS "EXAM_TTL" , QUIZ.EXAM_CTS AS "EXAM_CTS" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_MNTS AS "EXAM_MNTS" , QUIZ.MRK_RFLTYN AS "MRK_RFLTYN" , QUIZ.MRK_OYN AS "MRK_OYN" , QUIZ.QSTN_DSPLY_GBNCD AS "QSTN_DSPLY_GBNCD" , QUIZ.QSTN_RNDMYN AS "QSTN_RNDMYN" , QUIZ.QSTN_VWITM_RNDMYN AS "QSTN_VWITM_RNDMYN" , SBST.EXAM_EVL_SBST_ID AS "EXAM_EVL_SBST_ID" , QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST SBST ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC QUIZ ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AND QUIZ.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL QUIZ_DTL ON QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND QUIZ_DTL.DELYN ='N' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectAbsnceRslt 설명 : 결시자 결시신청 결과 조회 */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABSNCE.REG_DTTM DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , ABSNCE.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD AS "ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD" , CMMN2.CDNM AS "ABSNCE_APLY_STSNM" , ABSNCE.APRVDTTM AS "APRVDTTM" , BSC.SBJCT_ID AS "SBJCT_ID" , SBJCT.SBJCTNM AS "SBJCTNM" , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NCKNM AS "DVCLAS_NCKNM" , ABSNCE.APRV_CTS AS "APRV_CTS" , DEPT.DEPTNM AS "DEPTNM" , SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AS "SMSTR_CHRT_ID" , CMMN1.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" , DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , PROF.USERNM AS "PROFNM" , '' AS "TUTNM" /* 튜터 정보로 수정 예정 */ -- , USR.USER_RPRS_ID AS "USER_RPRS_ID" , USR.STDNT_NO AS "STDNT_NO" , USR.USERNM AS "USERNM" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = ABSNCE.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" , ABSNCE.ABSNCE_TTL AS "ABSNCE_TTL" , ABSNCE.ABSNCE_RFLTRT AS "ABSNCE_RFLTRT" , ABSNCE.ABSNCE_CTS AS "ABSNCE_CTS" , ABSNCE.EXAM_ABSNCE_ID AS "EXAM_ABSNCE_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABSNCE ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ABSNCE.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF ON BSC.RGTR_ID = PROF.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID JOIN (SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID , MIN(EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM) AS EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE DELYN ='N' GROUP BY EXAM_BSC_ID ) DTL ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN1 ON BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = CMMN1.CD AND CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN2 ON ABSNCE.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = CMMN2.CD AND CMMN2.UP_CD = 'ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND ABSNCE.USER_ID = #{userId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N' ) T WHERE T.LINE_NO = 1

CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = USR.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" , CASE WHEN USR.SNRYN = 'Y' THEN 'Seniors' ELSE 'Disabled' END AS "USER_STATUS" , CMMN1.CDNM AS "DSBL_TYNM" , CMMN2.CDNM AS "DSBL_GRDNM" , ATN.SBJCT_ID AS "SBJCT_ID" , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NCKNM AS "DVCLAS_NCKNM" , SBJCT.SBJCTNM AS "SBJCTNM" , SPRT_MID.REG_DTTM AS "REG_DTTM" , CMMN3.CDNM AS "EXAM_SPRT_APLY_TYNM" , DTL_MID.EXAM_MNTS AS "MID_EXAM_MNTS" , SPRT_MID.ADD_MNTS AS "SPRT_MID_ADD_MNTS" , DTL_LST.EXAM_MNTS AS "LST_EXAM_MNTS" , SPRT_LST.ADD_MNTS AS "SPRT_LST_ADD_MNTS" FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATN JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATN.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID AND (USR.DSBLYN = 'Y' OR USR.SNRYN = 'Y') JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON USR.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID /* 중간 고사 */ JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC_MID ON ATN.SBJCT_ID = BSC_MID.SBJCT_ID AND BSC_MID.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%EXAM_MID%' AND BSC_MID.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_SPRT_APLY SPRT_MID ON BSC_MID.EXAM_BSC_ID = SPRT_MID.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ATN.USER_ID = SPRT_MID.USER_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT EXAM_MNTS , EXAM_BSC_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL A WHERE A.DELYN ='N') DTL_MID ON BSC_MID.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL_MID.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 기말 고사 */ JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC_LST ON ATN.SBJCT_ID = BSC_LST.SBJCT_ID AND BSC_LST.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%EXAM_LST%' AND BSC_LST.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_SPRT_APLY SPRT_LST ON BSC_LST.EXAM_BSC_ID = SPRT_LST.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ATN.USER_ID = SPRT_LST.USER_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT EXAM_MNTS , EXAM_BSC_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL A WHERE A.DELYN ='N') DTL_LST ON BSC_LST.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL_LST.EXAM_BSC_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN1 ON USR.DSBL_TYCD = CMMN1.CD AND CMMN1.UP_CD = 'DSBL_TYCD' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN2 ON USR.DSBL_GRDCD = CMMN2.CD AND CMMN2.UP_CD = 'DSBL_GRDCD' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN3 ON USR.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_TYCD = CMMN3.CD AND CMMN3.UP_CD = 'EXAM_SPRT_APLY_TYCD' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON ATN.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID WHERE ATN.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATN.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectProfQuizMng 설명 : 교수 퀴즈관리 퀴즈 조회 */ SELECT QUIZ.EXAM_TTL AS "EXAM_TTL" , QUIZ.EXAM_CTS AS "EXAM_CTS" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_MNTS AS "EXAM_MNTS" , QUIZ.MRK_RFLTYN AS "MRK_RFLTYN" , QUIZ.MRK_OYN AS "MRK_OYN" , QUIZ.QSTN_DSPLY_GBNCD AS "QSTN_DSPLY_GBNCD" , QUIZ.QSTN_RNDMYN AS "QSTN_RNDMYN" , QUIZ.QSTN_VWITM_RNDMYN AS "QSTN_VWITM_RNDMYN" , QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_EXAMQUIZ ONQZ ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = ONQZ.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC QUIZ ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AND QUIZ.DELYN ='N' JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT QD.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY QD.EXAM_BSC_ID ORDER BY QD.EXAM_DTL_ID DESC) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL QD WHERE QD.DELYN ='N') WHERE RN = 1 ) QUIZ_DTL ON QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.listExamMidLst 설명 : 중간,기말 시험 ID 목록 조회 */ SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" , EXAM_GBNCD AS "EXAM_GBNCD" , SBJCT_ID AS "SBJCT_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND (EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%MID%' OR EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%LST%') AND EXAM_TYCD = 'EXAM' AND DELYN = 'N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectExamQuizBscId 설명 : 퀴즈 시험아이디 조회 */ SELECT QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC /* 온라인시험퀴즈 */ JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_EXAMQUIZ ONQZ ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = ONQZ.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 시험 > 시험 퀴즈 조회용도 */ JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC QUIZ ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AND QUIZ.DELYN = 'N' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TO_DATE(DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC , BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID ASC) AS "LINE_NO" , BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" , GBNCD.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" , BSC.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD AS "TKEXAM_MTHD_CD" , TKEXAM_MTHD.CDNM AS "TKEXAM_MTHD_NM" , BSC.EXAM_TTL AS "EXAM_TTL" , DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , DTL.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM" , DTL.EXAM_MNTS AS "EXAM_MNTS" , BSC.MRK_RFLTYN AS "MRK_RFLTYN" , CASE WHEN BSC.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = 'QUIZ' THEN CASE WHEN TKEXAM_QUIZ.TKEXAM_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END ELSE CASE WHEN TKEXAM_ONLN.TKEXAM_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END END AS "TKEXAM_YN" /* N - 미응시, Y - 응시 */ , CASE WHEN ABSNCE.EXAM_ABSNCE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "ABSNCE_YN" /* N - 결시 미승인, Y - 결시 승인 */ , CASE WHEN BSC.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = 'QUIZ' THEN TKEXAM_QUIZ.TOT_SCR /* 시험 - 퀴즈 점수 */ ELSE /* 온라인 시험의 경우 결시자면 대체 시험을 보도록 되어 있음 */ CASE WHEN ABSNCE.EXAM_ABSNCE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN SBST.EXAM_SBST_TYCD = 'SBST_ASMT' THEN TKEXAM_SBST_ASMT.SCR /* 대체 과제 점수 */ WHEN SBST.EXAM_SBST_TYCD = 'SBST_QUIZ' THEN TKEXAM_SBST_QUIZ.TOT_SCR /* 대체 퀴즈 점수 */ ELSE NULL END ELSE TKEXAM_ONLN.TOT_SCR /* 온라인 시험 점수 */ END END AS "TOT_SCR" , NVL(SBST.FDBK_CNT, 0) AS "FDBK_CNT" , BSC.BYTEAM_SUBREXAM_USEYN AS "BYTEAM_SUBREXAM_USEYN" , BSC.EXAMPPR_OYN AS "EXAMPPR_OYN" , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS "NOW_DTTM" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC /* 시험 상세 (1건만 추출) */ JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT D.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.EXAM_BSC_ID ORDER BY D.EXAM_DTL_ID DESC) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D WHERE D.DELYN ='N') WHERE RN = 1 ) DTL ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 시험 응시 (실시간 온라인) */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , TK.TKEXAM_ID , RSLT.TOT_SCR FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATD ON ATD.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID AND ATD.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ATD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATD.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON TK.TKEXAM_ID = RSLT.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' /* 학습자에 대한 시험 평가가 완료 되어야 함 */ WHERE TK.USER_ID = #{userId}) TKEXAM_ONLN ON TKEXAM_ONLN.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 시험 응시 (퀴즈) */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , TK.TKEXAM_ID , RSLT.TOT_SCR FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_EXAMQUIZ ONQZ ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON ONQZ.QUIZ_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATD ON ATD.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID AND ATD.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ATD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATD.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON TK.TKEXAM_ID = RSLT.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' /* 학습자에 대한 시험 평가가 완료 되어야 함 */ WHERE TK.USER_ID = #{userId}) TKEXAM_QUIZ ON TKEXAM_QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST SBST ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 시험 응시 (대체 과제) */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT ASMT.ASMT_ID , EVL.SCR FROM TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL ON ASMT.ASMT_ID = EVL.ASMT_ID AND EVL.USER_ID = #{userId}) TKEXAM_SBST_ASMT ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = TKEXAM_SBST_ASMT.ASMT_ID /* 시험 응시 (대체 퀴즈) */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID , TK.TKEXAM_ID , RSLT.TOT_SCR FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND BSC.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATD ON ATD.SBJCT_ID = BSC.SBJCT_ID AND ATD.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ATD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATD.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON TK.TKEXAM_ID = RSLT.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' /* 학습자에 대한 시험 평가가 완료 되어야 함 */ WHERE TK.USER_ID = #{userId}) TKEXAM_SBST_QUIZ ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = TKEXAM_SBST_QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 대체 시험 (과제만) */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT EB.EXAM_BSC_ID , SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID , COUNT(ASFD.ASMT_FDBK_ID) AS "FDBK_CNT" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EB LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST SBST ON EB.EXAM_BSC_ID = SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID AND SBST.EXAM_SBST_TYCD = 'SBST_ASMT' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_FDBK ASFD ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = ASFD.ASMT_ID AND ASFD.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE EB.DELYN ='N' GROUP BY EB.EXAM_BSC_ID , SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID) SBST ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 결시 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT EB.EXAM_BSC_ID , ABSNCE.EXAM_ABSNCE_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EB LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABSNCE ON EB.EXAM_BSC_ID = ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ABSNCE.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' AND ABSNCE.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE EB.DELYN ='N') ABSNCE ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD GBNCD ON BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = GBNCD.CD AND GBNCD.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD TKEXAM_MTHD ON BSC.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = TKEXAM_MTHD.CD AND TKEXAM_MTHD.UP_CD = 'TKEXAM_MTHD_CD' WHERE BSC.EXAM_TYCD = 'EXAM' AND BSC.DELYN = 'N' AND BSC.EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' AND BSC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND BSC.EXAM_TTL LIKE '%' || #{examTtl} || '%'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (CASE WHEN BSC.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%LST%' THEN 1 /* 기말고사 */ WHEN BSC.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%MID%' THEN 2 /* 중간고사 */ ELSE 3 END) ASC , TO_DATE(ABSN.REG_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" , ABSN.EXAM_ABSNCE_ID AS "EXAM_ABSNCE_ID" , SBJCT.SBJCTNM AS "SBJCTNM" , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NCKNM AS "DVCLAS_NCKNM" , CMMN1.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" , ABSN.REG_DTTM AS "REG_DTTM" , CASE WHEN ABSN.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APLY' THEN 1 /* 신청 */ WHEN ABSN.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'RE_APLY' THEN 2 /* 재신청 */ WHEN ABSN.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' THEN 3 /* 승인 */ WHEN ABSN.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'RJCT' THEN 4 /* 거절 */ END AS "ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD" , CMMN2.CDNM AS "ABSNCE_APLY_STSNM" , CMMN3.CDNM AS "TKEXAM_MTHD_NM" , ABSN.APRVDTTM AS "APRVDTTM" , ABSN.USER_ID AS "USER_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABSN ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = ABSN.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ABSN.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN1 ON BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = CMMN1.CD AND CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN2 ON ABSN.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = CMMN2.CD AND CMMN2.UP_CD = 'ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD' JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN3 ON BSC.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = CMMN3.CD AND CMMN3.UP_CD = 'TKEXAM_MTHD_CD' WHERE BSC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY T.MID_EXAM_BSC_ID) AS "LINE_NO" , T.* FROM (SELECT DEPT.DEPTNM AS "DEPTNM" , SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AS "SMSTR_CHRT_ID" , SBJCT.SBJCTNM AS "SBJCTNM" , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NCKNM AS "DVCLAS_NCKNM" , CMMN1.CDNM || '/' || CMMN2.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" , MID.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "MID_EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , LST.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "LST_EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , PROF.USERNM AS "PROFNM" , '' AS "TUTNM" /* 튜터 정보로 수정 예정 */ -- , USR.USER_RPRS_ID AS "USER_RPRS_ID" , USR.STDNT_NO AS "STDNT_NO" , USR.USERNM AS "USERNM" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = ATND.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" , FN_DTTM() AS "NOW_DTTM" , MID.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "MID_EXAM_BSC_ID" , LST.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "LST_EXAM_BSC_ID" /* 시험 지원은 '시간연장' 말고 없다... */ , '시간연장 / 시간연장' AS "EXAM_SPRT_APLY_TYNM" , CASE WHEN MID.APLY_STSCD = LST.APLY_STSCD AND MID.APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' THEN CASE WHEN MID.ADD_MNTS IS NULL THEN '부여하지 않음' ELSE '연장(' || MID.ADD_MNTS || '분)' END || ' / ' || CASE WHEN LST.ADD_MNTS IS NULL THEN '부여하지 않음' ELSE '연장(' || LST.ADD_MNTS || '분)' END WHEN MID.APLY_STSCD = LST.APLY_STSCD AND MID.APLY_STSCD = 'RJCT' THEN '반려' ELSE '-' END AS "SPRT_RSLT" , MID.ADD_MNTS AS "SPRT_MID_ADD_MNTS" , LST.ADD_MNTS AS "SPRT_LST_ADD_MNTS" , MID.APLY_STSCD AS "MID_APLY_STSCD" , LST.APLY_STSCD AS "LST_APLY_STSCD" , CMMN3.CDNM || '/' || CMMN4.CDNM AS "APLY_STSNM" , MID.CNCL_APLY_STSCD AS "MID_CNCL_APLY_STSCD" , LST.CNCL_APLY_STSCD AS "LST_CNCL_APLY_STSCD" , CMMN5.CDNM || '/' || CMMN6.CDNM AS "CNCL_APLY_STSNM" , MID.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID AS "MID_EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID" , LST.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID AS "LST_EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATND ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = ATND.SBJCT_ID AND ATND.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON ATND.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATND.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF ON BSC.RGTR_ID = PROF.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID /* 중간고사 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TO_DATE(MID.REG_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC) "RN" , MID.EXAM_BSC_ID , MID.SBJCT_ID , MID.EXAM_GBNCD , SPRT_MID.APLY_STSCD , SPRT_MID.ADD_MNTS , SPRT_MID.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID , SPRT_MID.CNCL_APLY_STSCD , DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC MID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_SPRT_APLY SPRT_MID ON MID.EXAM_BSC_ID = SPRT_MID.EXAM_BSC_ID AND SPRT_MID.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN (SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID , MIN(EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM) AS EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE DELYN ='N' GROUP BY EXAM_BSC_ID ) DTL ON MID.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%MID%' AND MID.DELYN ='N') MID ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = MID.SBJCT_ID AND MID.RN = 1 /* 기말고사 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TO_DATE(LST.REG_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC) "RN" , LST.EXAM_BSC_ID , LST.SBJCT_ID , LST.EXAM_GBNCD , SPRT_LST.APLY_STSCD , SPRT_LST.ADD_MNTS , SPRT_LST.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID , SPRT_LST.CNCL_APLY_STSCD , DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC LST LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_SPRT_APLY SPRT_LST ON LST.EXAM_BSC_ID = SPRT_LST.EXAM_BSC_ID AND SPRT_LST.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN (SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID , MIN(EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM) AS EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE DELYN ='N' GROUP BY EXAM_BSC_ID ) DTL ON LST.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%LST%' AND LST.DELYN ='N') LST ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = LST.SBJCT_ID AND LST.RN = 1 /* 중간고사 구분 코드 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN1 ON MID.EXAM_GBNCD = CMMN1.CD AND CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' /* 기말고사 구분 코드 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN2 ON LST.EXAM_GBNCD = CMMN2.CD AND CMMN2.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' /* 중간고사 시험지원 상태코드 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN3 ON MID.APLY_STSCD = CMMN3.CD AND CMMN3.UP_CD = 'APLY_STSCD' /* 기말고사 시험지원 상태코드 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN4 ON LST.APLY_STSCD = CMMN4.CD AND CMMN4.UP_CD = 'APLY_STSCD' /* 중간고사 시험지원 취소 상태코드 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN5 ON MID.CNCL_APLY_STSCD = CMMN5.CD AND CMMN5.UP_CD = 'CNCL_APLY_STSCD' /* 기말고사 시험지원 취소 상태코드 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN6 ON LST.CNCL_APLY_STSCD = CMMN6.CD AND CMMN6.UP_CD = 'CNCL_APLY_STSCD' WHERE BSC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N') T WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : ExamDAO.listStdntExamPaging 설명 : 학습자 시험 목록 페이징 */
/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.countStdntExam 설명 : 학습자 시험 목록 카운트 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM () Z
/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.stdntDsblSnrYn 설명 : 학습자 장애인/고령자 여부 */ SELECT CASE WHEN SNRYN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN DSBLYN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "SNR_DSBLYN" FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntSbstAsmtId 설명 : 학습자 대체과제 ID 조회 */ SELECT EXAM_SBST_ID AS "ASMT_ID" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST WHERE EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND EXAM_SBST_TYCD = 'SBST_ASMT'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntSbstAsmtFdbkInfo 설명 : 학습자 대체과제 피드백 기본정보 조회 */ SELECT DEPT.DEPTNM , USR.STDNT_NO , USR.USERNM , EVL.SCR AS "ASMT_SCR" FROM TB_LMS_USER USR JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON USR.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL ON USR.USER_ID = EVL.USER_ID AND EVL.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntTkexamHist 설명 : 학습자 시험 응시기록 조회 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TO_DATE(HSTRY.TKEXAM_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') ASC) AS "LINE_NO" , CMMN.CDNM AS "EXAM_HSTRY_GBNNM" , HSTRY.TKEXAM_SDTTM , HSTRY.TKEXAM_EDTTM , ROUND((TO_DATE(HSTRY.TKEXAM_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_DATE(HSTRY.TKEXAM_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) * 86400) AS "TKEXAM_DRTN" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_HSTRY HSTRY ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = HSTRY.EXAM_DTL_ID AND HSTRY.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN ON HSTRY.EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD = CMMN.CD AND CMMN.UP_CD = 'EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntTkexamRslt 설명 : 학습자 시험 응시결과 조회 */ SELECT TKEXAM.TKEXAM_SDTTM AS "TKEXAM_SDTTM" , TKEXAM.TKEXAM_MNTS AS "TKEXAM_MNTS" , RSLT.TOT_SCR AS "TOT_SCR" , TKEXAM.TKEXAM_CMPTNYN AS "TKEXAM_CMPTNYN" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TKEXAM ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TKEXAM.EXAM_DTL_ID AND TKEXAM.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON TKEXAM.TKEXAM_ID = RSLT.TKEXAM_ID AND RSLT.EVLYN = 'Y' /* 학습자에 대한 시험 평가가 완료 되어야 함 */ WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND TKEXAM.TKEXAM_ID IS NOT NULL /* 팀 시험인 경우 대비용... */ AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntDtlIdAndTeamId 설명 : 학습자 시험상세 ID 및 팀 ID 조회 */ SELECT DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID , MBR.TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND DTL.DELYN ='N' JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR TRGTR ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR ON TRGTR.TEAM_ID = MBR.TEAM_ID AND MBR.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntQuizDtlId 설명 : 학습자 퀴즈 상세 아이디 조회 */ SELECT DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND DTL.DELYN = 'N' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN = 'N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntSbstInfo 설명 : 학습자 대체 시험 조회 */ SELECT BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "EXAM_BSC_ID" , SBST.EXAM_EVL_SBST_ID AS "EXAM_EVL_SBST_ID" , CMMN1.CDNM AS "EXAM_EVL_SBSTNM" , CASE WHEN ASMT.ASMT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ASMT' /* 과제 */ WHEN QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'QUIZ' /* 퀴즈 */ END AS "GBN" /* 과제 */ , ASMT.ASMT_ID AS "ASMT_ID" , ASMT.ASMT_TTL AS "ASMT_TTL" , ASMT.ASMT_CTS AS "ASMT_CTS" , ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM AS "ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM" , ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM AS "ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM" , ASMT.EVL_SCR_TYCD AS "EVL_SCR_TYCD" , CMMN2.CDNM AS "EVL_SCR_TYNM" , ASMT.SBMSN_FILE_MIME_TYCD AS "SBMSN_FILE_MIME_TYCD" , ASMT.SBASMT_TYCD AS "SBASMT_TYCD" , NVL(ASFD.FDBK_CNT, 0) AS "FDBK_CNT" /* 퀴즈 */ , QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AS "QUIZ_BSC_ID" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID AS "EXAM_DTL_ID" , QUIZ.EXAM_TTL AS "EXAM_TTL" , QUIZ.EXAM_CTS AS "EXAM_CTS" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_EDTTM" , SBST.REG_DTTM AS "REG_DTTM" , QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_MNTS AS "EXAM_MNTS" , QUIZ.EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN AS "EXAM_QSTNS_CMPTNYN" , QUIZ.EXAM_GRP_ID AS "EXAM_GRP_ID" , QUIZ.EXAMPPR_OYN AS "EXAMPPR_OYN" , CMMN3.CDNM AS "QSTN_DSPLY_GBNNM" , QUIZ.QSTN_RNDMYN AS "QSTN_RNDMYN" , QUIZ.QSTN_VWITM_RNDMYN AS "QSTN_VWITM_RNDMYN" /* 공통 */ , CASE WHEN ASMT.ASMT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ASMT.MRK_RFLTYN ELSE QUIZ.MRK_RFLTYN END AS "MRK_RFLTYN" , CASE WHEN ASMT.ASMT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ASMT.MRK_OYN ELSE QUIZ.MRK_OYN END AS "MRK_OYN" FROM /* 시험 기본 */ TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC /* 시험 대체 평가 */ JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST SBST ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN1 ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_TYCD = CMMN1.CD AND CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_SBST_TYCD' /* 과제 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = ASMT.SBJCT_ID AND SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = ASMT.ASMT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN2 ON ASMT.EVL_SCR_TYCD = CMMN2.CD AND CMMN2.UP_CD = 'EVL_SCR_TYCD' LEFT JOIN (SELECT B.ASMT_ID , COUNT(B.ASMT_FDBK_ID) AS "FDBK_CNT" FROM TB_LMS_ASMT A JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_FDBK B ON A.ASMT_ID = B.ASMT_ID AND B.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY B.ASMT_ID) ASFD ON ASMT.ASMT_ID = ASFD.ASMT_ID /* 퀴즈 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC QUIZ ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID AND QUIZ.DELYN ='N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL QUIZ_DTL ON QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID = QUIZ_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND QUIZ_DTL.DELYN ='N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN3 ON QUIZ.QSTN_DSPLY_GBNCD = CMMN3.CD AND CMMN3.UP_CD = 'QSTN_DSPLY_GBNCD' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID =#{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N'

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntSbstAsmtSbmtHist 설명 : 학습자 대체 과제 제출기록 조회 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TO_DATE(SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , CASE WHEN SBMSN.SBMSN_TYCD = 'FILE' THEN ATFL.FILENM ELSE SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT END AS "FILENM" FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBMSN /* 첨부파일 Todo : 과제 전용 첨부파일 테이블로 변경 가능성 있음. */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ATFL ATFL ON SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = ATFL.REF_ID WHERE SBMSN.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND SBMSN.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntSbstAsmtRslt 설명 : 학습자 대체 과제 평가결과 조회 */ SELECT EVL.ASMT_EVL_ID , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , CASE WHEN SBMSN.SBMSN_TYCD = 'FILE' THEN ATFL.FILENM ELSE SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT END AS "FILENM" , EVL.SCR AS "ASMT_SCR" FROM TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TO_DATE(SBMSN_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC) AS "RN" , ASMT_SBMSN_ID , USER_ID , ASMT_ID , SBMSN_TYCD , SBMSN_TXT , SBMSN_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ASMT_ID = #{asmtId}) WHERE RN = 1) SBMSN ON ASMT.ASMT_ID = SBMSN.ASMT_ID AND SBMSN.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL ON SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = EVL.ASMT_SBMSN_ID AND EVL.EVLYN = 'Y' /* 학습자에 대한 과제 평가가 완료 되어야 함 */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ATFL ATFL ON SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = ATFL.REF_ID WHERE ASMT.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId}

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectStdntAbsnceInfo 설명 : 학습자 결시신청 기본정보 조회 */ SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABSNCE.REG_DTTM DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , DEPT.DEPTNM , SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NCKNM , CMMN1.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" , DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , PROF.USERNM AS "PROFNM" , '' AS "TUTNM" /* 튜터 정보로 수정 예정 */ -- , USR.USER_RPRS_ID , USR.STDNT_NO , USR.USERNM AS "USERNM" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = ATND.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" , FN_DTTM() AS "NOW_DTTM" /* 재신청일 경우 사용 */ , ABSNCE.ABSNCE_CTS AS "ABSNCE_CTS" FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATND ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = ATND.SBJCT_ID AND ATND.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON BSC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATND.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF ON BSC.RGTR_ID = PROF.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID JOIN (SELECT EXAM_BSC_ID , MIN(EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM) AS EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL WHERE DELYN ='N' GROUP BY EXAM_BSC_ID ) DTL ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABSNCE ON BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = ABSNCE.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ATND.USER_ID = ABSNCE.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN1 ON BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = CMMN1.CD AND CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' WHERE BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{examBscId} AND BSC.DELYN ='N') T WHERE T.LINE_NO = 1

/* SQL ID : ExamDAO.selectAdmSprtAplyDtl 설명 : 관리자 장애인/고령자 지원관리 상세보기 */ SELECT DEPT.DEPTNM , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NCKNM , STD.USERNM , STD.STDNT_NO , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = STD.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" , CASE WHEN STD.DSBLYN = 'Y' THEN 'Disabled' WHEN STD.SNRYN = 'Y' THEN 'Seniors' END AS "USER_STATUS" , CMMN1.CDNM AS "EXAM_SPRT_APLY_TYNM" , CMMN2.CDNM AS "DSBL_TYNM" , CMMN3.CDNM AS "DSBL_GRDNM" , PROF.USERNM AS "PROFNM" , '' AS "TUTNM" -- Todo: 튜터 정보 가져오기 , MID_CMMN1.CDNM || ' / ' || LST_CMMN1.CDNM AS "EXAM_GBNNM" , MID_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "MID_EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" , LST_DTL.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM AS "LST_EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM" /* 중간/기말 신청 내용이 동일하므로 중간고사의 신청 내용을 사용 */ , MID_SPRT.SPRT_APLY_CTS , MID_DTL.EXAM_MNTS AS "MID_EXAM_MNTS" , LST_DTL.EXAM_MNTS AS "LST_EXAM_MNTS" , CASE WHEN (MID_SPRT.APLY_STSCD = 'APLY' AND LST_SPRT.APLY_STSCD = 'APLY') THEN 'Y' WHEN (MID_SPRT.APLY_STSCD = 'RE_APLY' AND LST_SPRT.APLY_STSCD = 'RE_APLY') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "GUBUN" , MID_SPRT.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_GRP_ID , MID_SPRT.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID AS "MID_EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID" , LST_SPRT.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID AS "LST_EXAM_SPRT_APLY_ID" FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATND JOIN TB_LMS_USER STD ON ATND.USER_ID = STD.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON STD.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON ATND.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF ON SBJCT.PROF_ID = PROF.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN1 ON STD.EXAM_SPRT_APLY_TYCD = CMMN1.CD AND CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_SPRT_APLY_TYCD' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN2 ON STD.DSBL_TYCD = CMMN2.CD AND CMMN2.UP_CD = 'DSBL_TYCD' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMMN3 ON STD.DSBL_GRDCD = CMMN3.CD AND CMMN3.UP_CD = 'DSBL_GRDCD' /* 중간고사 */ JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC MID_BSC ON ATND.SBJCT_ID = MID_BSC.SBJCT_ID AND MID_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%EXAM_MID%' AND MID_BSC.DELYN = 'N' JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT EXAM_BSC_ID , EXAM_MNTS , EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL A WHERE A.DELYN = 'N') MID_DTL ON MID_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = MID_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_SPRT_APLY MID_SPRT ON MID_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = MID_SPRT.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ATND.USER_ID = MID_SPRT.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD MID_CMMN1 ON MID_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = MID_CMMN1.CD AND MID_CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' /* 기말고사 */ JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC LST_BSC ON ATND.SBJCT_ID = LST_BSC.SBJCT_ID AND LST_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD LIKE '%EXAM_LST%' AND LST_BSC.DELYN = 'N' JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT EXAM_BSC_ID , EXAM_MNTS , EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL A WHERE A.DELYN = 'N') LST_DTL ON LST_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = LST_DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_SPRT_APLY LST_SPRT ON LST_BSC.EXAM_BSC_ID = LST_SPRT.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ATND.USER_ID = LST_SPRT.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD LST_CMMN1 ON LST_BSC.EXAM_GBNCD = LST_CMMN1.CD AND LST_CMMN1.UP_CD = 'EXAM_GBNCD' WHERE ATND.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATND.USER_ID = #{userId}
